desktop_tcp_disconnect.ownership_note: Terminal supervisor state requires its original guardian handles/readers. The separate audit queries only baseline PID liveness; no PID is adopted or killed. Windows may retain an already exited process object.
desktop_tcp_disconnect.trigger: One Windows SetTcpEntry DELETE_TCB on the established managed desktop connection to Kali
desktop_tcp_disconnect.selector: Exact IPv4 endpoints and peer ephemeral port; approved image hash, original process handle/creation time, owner, session argv and fresh authenticated status rechecked
desktop_tcp_disconnect.selector_limit: The Windows API selects a four-tuple, not a socket handle; a residual check-to-use tuple reuse race remains.

wayland_os_grant_revocation.ownership_note: Terminal supervisor state requires its original guardian handles/readers. The separate audit queries only baseline PID liveness; no PID is adopted or killed. Windows may retain an already exited process object.
wayland_os_grant_revocation.trigger: Operator confirmed clicking GNOME Stop Screen Sharing on Ubuntu
wayland_os_grant_revocation.source_of_action_evidence: Human confirmation of the real GNOME command; termination and no-restart samples independently authenticated
wayland_os_grant_revocation.observation_note: First 150-second observation ended while awaiting the operator. Preserved separately; the longer continuation also captured all three nodes ready before the click and then terminal for at least 30 seconds.

limitations: TCP close handling does not measure silent idle packet loss.
The GNOME click is operator-confirmed, not browser or UI automation.
No latency from the physical click is measured.
